topics.title: Start
topics.teach: You will make a drawing run by a program and a three-screen app. Weaving is the shared example, not a weaving certificate. Read the route, then start the pre-check.

topics.title: Algorithms
topics.teach: An algorithm is a sequence of instructions for a task. A program is instructions a computer can execute. Write a familiar sequence, revise one vague step, then sort the card stack, the blocks, and the swapped cards.

items.label: Card stack a person can follow

fields.name: reason
fields.label: Why did you choose that category?

topics.title: Building blocks
topics.teach: Sequence, loop, conditional, and program are different jobs. Shoes then walking is a sequence. Stirring until thick is a loop. An umbrella when it rains is a conditional. A recipe a machine can run is a program.

items.label: Brush, then put the shoes away
A recipe a machine can run

fields.name: repeated
fields.label: In the rice example, what repeats?

topics.title: Weave
topics.teach: This is virtual. No real leaves are needed. Save a proposed order and one dependency. The full weave order is still under review. Then order boil, bag, pour, and drink from the stated prerequisites.

fields.name: dependency
fields.label: Which card has to come first, and what changes in the leaf?

fields.name: first_card
fields.label: First of the two cards you are comparing

topics.title: Parts
topics.teach: The whole ordered list is the algorithm. Fold and roll repeat until about 4 inches remain. The cube card is the if. A longer leaf changes the number of repeats. The 4-inch check stays.

topics.title: Draw
topics.teach: The square is a repeat of equal moves and quarter turns. A triangle is only the demonstration of an exterior turn. The practice shape after that is a hexagon. The pattern is inspired by a rose and is not a weaving simulation.

topics.title: App
topics.teach: The reference app is What is lauhala, How the rose is made, then Finished rose, with a way back. A button press is an event. Walk screen 1 to 2 to 3 and back to 1 in the preview.

topics.title: Wrap
topics.teach: Connect the algorithm, the instructions the computer executed, and the output. One short connection is enough.

fields.name: response
fields.label: What was the algorithm, what did the computer execute, and what was the output?
